1. Create a platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read*** and ***storage:events:read*** scopes following [these instructions](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens). 
 2. Use your Dynatrace SaaS environment URL in the format ***xyz.apps.dynatrace.com***. Classic Dynatrace environments (***xxx.live.dynatrace.com***) are not supported.

request.queryParametersTemplate:
{"query": "fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) OR not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| fieldsAdd duration = coalesce(event.end, now()) - event.start,
    affected_entities_count = arraySize(affected_entity_ids),
    affected_entity_ids = affected_entity_ids,
    affected_entity_names = affected_entity_names,
    smartscape.affected_entity.ids = smartscape.affected_entity.ids,
    event_count = arraySize(dt.davis.event_ids),
    affected_users_count = dt.davis.affected_users_count,
    problem_id = event.id
| fields `display_id`, `event.name`, `event.description`, `event.status`, `event.category`, `event.start`, `event.end`, `root_cause_entity_id`, `root_cause_entity_name`, `duration`, `affected_entities_count`, `affected_entity_ids`, `affected_entity_names`, `smartscape.affected_entity.ids`, `affected_users_count`, `problem_id`, `dt.davis.impact_level`, `dt.davis.mute.status`, `dt.davis.mute.user`, `entity_tags`, `event_count`, `event.severity`, `maintenance.is_under_maintenance`
| sort `event.status` asc, `event.start` desc
| fieldsRename
    event_name = `event.name`,
    event_description = `event.description`,
    event_status = `event.status`,
    event_category = `event.category`,
    event_start = `event.start`,
    event_end = `event.end`,
    smartscape_affected_entity_ids = `smartscape.affected_entity.ids`,
    dt_davis_impact_level = `dt.davis.impact_level`,
    dt_davis_mute_status = `dt.davis.mute.status`,
    dt_davis_mute_user = `dt.davis.mute.user`,
    event_severity = `event.severity`,
    maintenance_is_under_maintenance = `maintenance.is_under_maintenance`", "defaultTimeframeStart": "{_QueryWindowStartTime}", "defaultTimeframeEnd": "{_QueryWindowEndTime}", "maxResultRecords": 100000, "requestTimeoutMilliseconds": 60000}

properties.description: Description about Consolidate Dynatrace Runtime Vulnerabilities - contentTemplate properties

Collapses raw Dynatrace runtime vulnerability events into one current-state row per
vulnerability, aggregating status across all affected entities.
Reads DynatraceSecurityProblemsV3Raw_CL, writes DynatraceSecurityProblemsV3_CL.

ruleDefinition.query:
let lookback = 24h;
DynatraceSecurityProblemsV3Raw_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by vulnerability_display_id, affected_entity_id
| summarize
    vulnerability_stack                      = take_any(vulnerability_stack),
    vulnerability_type                       = take_any(vulnerability_type),
    securityProblemTitle                     = take_any(vulnerability_title),
    vulnerability_references_cve             = take_any(vulnerability_references_cve),
    vulnerability_first_seen                 = max(todatetime(vulnerability_first_seen)),
    vulnerability_risk_score                 = round(max(iff(vulnerability_mute_status != "MUTED",
                                                 todouble(vulnerability_risk_score), 0.0)), 1),
    muteStatuses                             = make_set(vulnerability_mute_status),
    resolutionStatuses                       = make_set(vulnerability_resolution_status),
    functionStatuses                         = make_set(vulnerability_vulnerable_function_status),
    exposureStatuses                         = make_set(vulnerability_exposure_status),
    exploitStatuses                          = make_set(vulnerability_exploit_status),
    dataAssetStatuses                        = make_set(vulnerability_data_assets_status)
    by vulnerability_display_id
| extend
    vulnerability_resolution_status          = iff(set_has_element(resolutionStatuses, "OPEN"), "OPEN", "RESOLVED"),
    vulnerability_mute_status                = iff(set_has_element(muteStatuses, "NOT_MUTED"), "NOT_MUTED", "MUTED"),
    vulnerability_vulnerable_function_status = case(
        set_has_element(functionStatuses, "IN_USE"), "IN_USE",
        set_has_element(functionStatuses, "NOT_AVAILABLE"), "NOT_AVAILABLE",
        "NOT_IN_USE"),
    vulnerability_exposure_status            = case(
        set_has_element(exposureStatuses, "PUBLIC_NETWORK"), "PUBLIC_NETWORK",
        set_has_element(exposureStatuses, "NOT_AVAILABLE"), "NOT_AVAILABLE",
        "NOT_DETECTED"),
    vulnerability_exploit_status             = iff(set_has_element(exploitStatuses, "AVAILABLE"), "AVAILABLE", "NOT_AVAILABLE"),
    vulnerability_data_assets_status         = case(
        set_has_element(dataAssetStatuses, "REACHABLE"), "REACHABLE",
        set_has_element(dataAssetStatuses, "NOT_AVAILABLE"), "NOT_AVAILABLE",
        "NOT_DETECTED"),
    vulnerability_risk_level                 = case(
        vulnerability_risk_score >= 9,   "CRITICAL",
        vulnerability_risk_score >= 7,   "HIGH",
        vulnerability_risk_score >= 4,   "MEDIUM",
        vulnerability_risk_score >= 0.1, "LOW",
        "NONE")
| project
    vulnerability_display_id, securityProblemTitle, vulnerability_references_cve,
    vulnerability_first_seen, vulnerability_risk_score, vulnerability_risk_level,
    vulnerability_resolution_status, vulnerability_mute_status,
    vulnerability_vulnerable_function_status, vulnerability_exposure_status,
    vulnerability_data_assets_status, vulnerability_exploit_status,
    vulnerability_stack, vulnerability_type
